description: Added canon files 434-438 for sequencing, fuel cycle, climate-water siting, grid/load matching and propagation audit.
Expanded nuclear gate table from safety/delivery gates to include fuel cycle, HALEU, climate-water, grid interconnection, offtake, anti-crowding-out, lifecycle and public-benefit gates.
Added service-floor-wide audit determining whether nuclear assessment is favored, required, excepted or not directly applicable.
Added project archetypes and readiness triage to prevent indiscriminate equivalence among existing fleet, uprates, restarts, repeat build and SMR/advanced projects.
